senses.gloss:
चोलः (m. pl.) [चुल् कर्मणि घञ्]
N. of a country in southern
India, the modern Tanjore.
--लः, --ली
1 A short jacket, a bodice.
--2 A
garment reaching to the feet.
--लं
A garment.
--Comp.
--उंडुकः a
diadem, turban.

1 A breast-plate.
--2 A
bark-dress.
--3 A bodice.
--कं Bark,
rind.

चोलकिन् m.
1 A soldier armed with
a breast-plate.
--2 The orange tree.
--3 The wrist.
--4 The shoot of a
bamboo.

चोलं(लों)डुकः A fillet for
the head, a turban, tiara or diadem.

चोलं(लों)डुकः A fillet for
the head, a turban, tiara or diadem.

चोल N. of a country, situated on the banks of the
Kāverī and said to cover the southern portion of
Mysore. It was beyond the Kāverī, as Pulekaśi
II. invaded it after crossing the river. The
country latterly came to be called Karnāṭaka.
